The retained home-min-900x600.png visibly clips Light and hides Dark; focusing Dark at 200% scrolls the rail horizontally, as home-200-dark.png shows. My production-App probe opened the tenant list but ended with focus on Go to… rather than inside the list. Acceptance: Command-T from the palette closes it and leaves keyboard focus in the tenant list; Escape then returns focus to Switch tenant, without dispatching a tenant selection. Add a transition regression test and native verification.
